caption: The drawing features six stylized folk-art motifs rendered in red, yellow, and blue on a cream background. The motifs mainly consist of symmetrical floral and heart elements. At the top center, there is a large symmetrical plant with red leaves and branches and two circular yellow and blue decorations on either side. Below this, a large heart shape in yellow is outlined in blue and orange-red, with a pointed tip. Above the heart and to the right and left, there are two similar floral designs composed of a tulip-shaped flower in yellow and red with a blue section at the base, accompanied by stylized curving stems and a blue element within a heart shape below the flower. On the middle left, another motif displays a similar tulip above a heart and diamond shapes intersecting, primarily in yellow, red, and blue. The bottom left shows a more complex arrangement with two stylized red and yellow tulip flowers flanked by pinkish-red circular clusters, with blue star-like shapes at the ends and a blue rectangle at the base. On the bottom right sits a fuller arrangement of a yellow and red stylized flower with a dark blue base, curving leaf-like branches, and blue-and-yellow flower shapes on each side. The overall composition is symmetrical and balanced, with motifs evenly arranged and reminiscent of traditional Pennsylvania folk art patterns. The text at the bottom reads, in uppercase: “FROM STOVE PLATE, CAKE MOLD, FRAKTÜR PAINTING AND CERAMICS,” and below that, in smaller type, “FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA PLATE No. 6 INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN PENNA ART PROJECT W.P.A.”
title: Plate 6: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
